title: Rust Test Plan
description: A planned Rust test suite, described BEFORE the tests are written, so it can be audited for this skill's shibboleths (coverage theater, #[test] on async fn, mock echo, sleep-faked determinism, /tmp writes, an unasserted parity kernel-load, test deps outside [dev-dependencies]) with scripts/test_plan_audit.mjs.

tests.description: One entry per planned test. A plan with zero tests cannot be audited meaningfully.

kind.description: Where the test lives: #[cfg(test)] mod (unit), tests/ dir (integration), /// doc comment (doc), or benches/ (bench, not part of the test gate).

assertsValueNotType.description: True if the test asserts a specific value/variant/shape. False means it only checks is_ok()/is_some()/len()>0-style — coverage theater.

isAsync.description: True if the test function body is `async fn`.

usesTokioTestNotTest.description: True if an async test is attributed #[tokio::test] (or #[async_std::test]) rather than bare #[test]. Ignored when isAsync is false.

coverageTheaterRisk.description: True if this plan, taken as a whole, risks measuring execution instead of verification (assertions limited to is_ok/is_some/len()>0 across the suite).

testDepsInDevDeps.description: True if test-only crates (proptest, criterion, mockall, insta, rstest, tempfile, ...) are declared under [dev-dependencies], not [dependencies].

mockEcho.description: True if any planned test asserts a mock returns the exact value it was told to return (testing the mock framework, not the code).

fakesDeterminismWithSleeps.description: True if flakiness in an async/concurrent test is planned to be papered over with thread::sleep/tokio::time::sleep or a bare retry, instead of a readiness signal or a paused clock.

parityAssertsKernelLoaded.description: For cross-language/FFI parity tests: true if the plan asserts the native kernel/dylib actually loaded before comparing outputs. Set true when there is no parity test in this plan (vacuously satisfied).

writesToTmp.description: True if any planned test writes scratch data to a hardcoded /tmp path instead of tempfile::tempdir() or a repo-local scratch dir.
